title: Loan / Investment Optimization
short_description: Learn how financial planning systems select investments under budget constraints, maximize returns, evaluate multiple budget levels, determine feasible return thresholds, and optimize investment choices efficiently.

real_world_context.problem: A financial planning system needs to choose investment opportunities under constraints such as available budget and investment costs. The system must maximize expected returns, support partial investments, evaluate different budget levels, determine achievable return thresholds, and select the maximum number of affordable opportunities.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient optimization algorithms help financial planning systems make better use of limited capital while evaluating many possible investment choices and constraints.

learning_objectives: Understand how investment opportunities can be represented using costs and expected returns.
Apply 0/1 Knapsack to select investments that maximize return under a fixed budget.
Apply Fractional Knapsack when investment opportunities can be selected partially.
Use Dynamic Programming to determine the maximum return for multiple budget levels.
Apply Binary Search on Answer to determine the highest feasible investment return threshold.
Use Greedy techniques to maximize the number of investment opportunities selected within a fixed budget.
Understand how different constraints require different optimization strategies.
Understand why algorithm efficiency matters when evaluating a large number of investment opportunities.

real_world_mapping.investment: Opportunity that can be selected using available capital
real_world_mapping.investment_cost: Amount of capital required for an investment
real_world_mapping.expected_return: Return expected from selecting an investment
real_world_mapping.return_threshold: Minimum expected return value being evaluated
real_world_mapping.partial_investment: Fraction of an investment selected when full investment is not possible
real_world_mapping.investment_opportunity: Available investment option that can be selected or rejected

completion_message: You have completed the Loan / Investment Optimization mission. You have learned how 0/1 Knapsack, Fractional Knapsack, Dynamic Programming, Binary Search on Answer, and Greedy algorithms can be applied to investment selection, budget optimization, and financial planning problems.
